evals.prompt: set up a service catalog for our org
evals.expected_output: Wires catalog registration into the scaffolding path itself so it happens automatically rather than as a manual form, requires owner fields to resolve to a real group backing on-call and access control rather than free text, and adds a CI check that fails a pipeline on missing owner, tier, or repo-link metadata.

evals.prompt: during the incident nobody could figure out who owns this service
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses this as stale or missing catalog metadata and recommends a CI gate that fails on missing owner/tier fields plus a scheduled audit for orphaned entries with owner groups that no longer exist, since a stale entry is worse than no entry.

evals.prompt: let's just put 'owned by platform team' as a text field in the catalog
evals.expected_output: Pushes back that a free-text owner string is not queryable, pageable, or enforceable, and requires the owner field to resolve to a real identity/group tied to an actual on-call rotation and access-control group instead.
